interpretation: clone-count augmentation for per-mother risk estimation; no intervention claims
selection_rationale: Precision round for the 35 held-out compact-16 mothers: 32 additional independent clones of the original arm (new master seed, so new clone seeds; existing 16-clone results are kept and pooled in the analysis to 48 clones per mother). Purpose: shrink the branch-level binomial noise floor of per-mother q_B from q(1-q)/15 to q(1-q)/47 so the previously detected mother-level risk heterogeneity (excess SD 11.1pp, p=0.0035) can be separated from measurement noise and re-tested against descriptors. No arm comparisons here.
